title: GTA 6 Trailer 1 Revisited: Community Discusses Character Models and Social Media
description: The GTA 6 Reddit community is revisiting the first trailer, discussing how Jason and Lucia's character models compare and why modern social media elements matter.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Looking Back at GTA 6 Trailer 1: Community Insights and Reactions

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, the r/GTA6 community on Reddit has been taking a trip down memory lane. Players have been actively discussing their honest opinions on the very first GTA 6 trailer, shedding light on character model evolutions and how the game captures the modern digital age.

### Character Model Evolution: Jason and Lucia

Reflecting on the initial reveal, some community members noted that male protagonist Jason looked a bit unusual in that first trailer. Fortunately, many agree that his appearance received noticeable improvements in subsequent footage. On the other hand, female protagonist Lucia has enjoyed overwhelmingly positive reception from day one, with her look remaining consistently praised by the community.

Such visual refinements during the multi-year development cycle of a massive open-world title are quite standard. Early promotional material often captures builds that are still undergoing optimization and polishing before the final release.

### The Role of Modern Social Media in Vice City

Another major talking point from the trailer is the inclusion of numerous simulated social media clips and vertical video feeds. While some viewers were initially divided on this stylistic choice, looking back, it makes total sense given that GTA 6 takes place in the modern day.

The landscape of social media has evolved dramatically since the 2013 era of GTA 5. Community discussions suggest that social media may play a much larger role in the game, potentially extending far beyond the boundaries of the main story missions to shape the living, breathing environment of the game world.

Ultimately, revisiting the first trailer highlights just how deeply the community analyzes every single frame while waiting for the next big update from Rockstar Games.

## Editor's Take
Revisiting the first GTA 6 trailer reminds us of the incredible passion within the community. The ongoing discussions about character refinements and social media integration show that players are eager for a truly contemporary open-world experience. These community insights capture the evolving nature of game development and the heightened expectations surrounding Rockstar's next masterpiece.
